summary: Implement end-to-end encryption for Azure SQL Database, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) and Always Encrypted features, to secure data at rest and in transit.
description: This project focuses on implementing end-to-end encryption for Azure SQL Database to ensure the highest level of data security. The implementation will include two critical features: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) and Always Encrypted. The project will involve a thorough assessment of the current database setup, configuration of encryption settings, testing of the encryption process, and documentation of the implementation steps. Additionally, we will provide training for your team to manage and maintain the encryption features effectively. This comprehensive approach will not only enhance data security but also ensure compliance with industry standards.
